text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a variety store's nail section, I spot 
Nishino Flower agonizing in front of the 
display.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Is this nail polish? There are so many 
types... I wonder which one is best.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The one on top is pretty good, IMO. 
Doesn't smudge, and dries super fast.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san...! No! This is, um...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ain't you buying nail polish?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me doing nails... it's, it's 
weird, isn't it? Just looking like an 
adult on the outside won't change 
anything, I know that already...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Which one d'you wanna get?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why not just grab one bottle of your fave 
color for now? I'll let you borrow my base 
coat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um... for the color, maybe pink... I 
think Bourbon-san might like it too...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gonna paint 'em together with Bourbon? 
Then... how about this kind of pink right 
here?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hold right there, Jordan-san! Pushy 
recommendations are forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You must properly listen to Flower-san's 
thoughts! First, let us confirm the 
initial objective of coming here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, what a drag. Let's go, Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "drag"?! As Class 
President, I am offering advice—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah jeez, then why don't you just tag along 
too, Bakushin O? And you too over there, 
peeping on us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Careful not to get it on the skin... All 
the way to the edges, as much as 
possible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The nail I lent as a test canvas turns a 
lovely pink. Nishino Flower paints my nail 
while receiving guidance from Tosen 
Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup, looking good. Just gotta let it dry 
and we're golden.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even applying it normally is so difficult. 
...I really am trying too hard to act 
grown-up, aren't I...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, look. Nails, or fashion in 
general— it's something you do for 
yourself, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Looking at your nails gets you hyped. 
Putting on makeup fires you up. Like, see? 
It's just like your racewear.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Indeed, putting on one's racewear 
truly fires up one's fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. So when you wanna look mature, 
you arm yourself with stylish clothes and 
makeup. Umm... hold on a sec.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan takes out a clear lip gloss 
from her pouch and applies it to Nishino 
Flower's lips.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How's that? You can barely see the 
difference, but inside, don't you feel 
totally hyped?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... Ehehe, somehow, I feel like I've 
become a little more grown-up...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Told ya. Starting from the outside is 
totally legit too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I wholeheartedly agree! As Class 
President, I always strive for neat and 
proper attire as well!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Bakushin O, your hair 
doesn't have a single stray strand, does 
it? Wait, are you super particular about 
that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you noticed? Tying up my hair 
tightens my discipline as well! Tying it 
cleanly activates Class President mode!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So it's the same for you, Bakushin 
O-san...! When I got my nails done during 
the Sweets Contest, it made me feel so 
grown-up too...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... going to practice doing nails! 
Jordan-san, thank you so much for teaching 
me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No prob. Come by anytime~.
